title: Reports show their DMARC outcome at a glance
result: every row of the reports table, the domain page's report table and the dashboard's Latest Reports carries a green check when all its messages pass DMARC (SPF or DKIM aligned) and an amber warning otherwise, with the count in the tooltip, e.g. "4 of 16 messages fail DMARC" (d4c4033, 6dc578e).
evidence: `test/reportDmarcOutcome.test.ts` and `test/describeDmarcOutcome.test.ts`; `pnpm run check:ci` exit 0 (146 files, 773 tests); deployed to nova and checked in the browser on a domain page showing both icons.
